node: Transmission-line hardware, fittings, conductor accessories, and installation-enabling components
summary: Layer 1B expanded the investable universe for transmission-line hardware and installation-enabling components. The clearest underfollowed candidate is Preformed Line Products, which appears unusually close to the node through formed-wire, conductor-support, splice, termination, substation connector, OPGW, and fiber hardware exposure. Hubbell is the main public reference peer for transmission components but has diluted exposure inside a much larger electrical-products platform. Arcosa and Valmont are not fittings pure-plays, but they are adjacent scarce infrastructure suppliers through engineered transmission, distribution, and substation structures. The key research question for later layers is whether hardware procurement, utility qualification, and line-installation productivity create earlier-cycle order signals than EPC revenue recognition.
